title: Matrix identities are hard: Fast blackbox PIT for noncommutative exponential-size constant-depth homogeneous circuits
read: Full Sections 2 through 6, including definitions, the depth-one and depth-two concentration arguments, the induction and final matrix-identity proof. The report page listed no revision when checked on 15 October 2026.
decisive_locations: pages 18-22: position map and coefficient-unit cancellation
scope: The registered counterexample targets the printed concentration implication and prescribed triangular detector. The paper's main abstract witness theorem, Amitsur theorem and a separate interpolation criticism are not certified or refuted here. Full third-party text remains private.
